title: Store Locator Map Builder: Locations Mapped
description: Rank pasted store coordinates by straight-line distance from a visitor point in your browser.
summary_sentence: This is a browser-based ranking tool, not a publishable store-locator service.
quick_answer: Paste lines in Name, latitude, longitude format, then choose a visitor point to rank stores by straight-line distance. The list stays in this tab; no deployable locator or directions are generated.

faq: What format should my location list be in?
Enter one store per line as Name, latitude, longitude. Store addresses are not geocoded by this tool.
Can I publish this as a locator?
No. This workspace ranks stores in the current tab; it does not create an embeddable multi-store application.
Does it provide driving directions or store hours?
No. Results show names and straight-line distances only.
The store list is processed in the browser tab. Location search and map tiles use external services, which receive the relevant search or map requests.
